programme.desc: The winner of the Dubai Duty Free Tennis Championships will receive a prize of $597,000 and 1,000 WTA ranking points. This season, a new queen of courts on the Persian Gulf coast will be selected. Last year's champion, Mirra Andreeva, was eliminated in the quarterfinals of the competition by Amanda Anisimova (6:2, 5:7, 6:7)

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Merida – singles final match: Cristina Bucsa – Magdalena Fręch
programme.desc: Mexico favors Magdalena Fręch. The Pole won her first WTA tournament in her career in Mexico in 2024. Now in Merida he has a chance for a second triumph. Cristina Bucsa wants to stop her. Our tennis player last faced the Spanish in Landisville in 2021. Fręch was victorious in this clash, winning 6:2, 6:3

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Indian Wells - singles final match: Aryna Sabalenka - Jelena Rybakina
programme.desc: The last two matches of these players ended with triumphs for Yelena Rybakina. Kazashka first beat the Belarusian in the WTA Finals, and then in the deciding match of the Australian Open. Now the world's third racket will try to stop the current ranking leader from winning her first title in Indian Wells

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Miami – 2nd round singles match: Magda Linette – Iga Świątek
programme.desc: Elimination in the quarterfinals in Indian Wells caused Iga Świątek to drop to 3rd place in the WTA ranking. However, the Pole can quickly return to 2nd place thanks to the competition in Miami. However, she must count on Jelena Rybakina's stumble and also reach at least the quarterfinals. The first tennis player who will try to prevent the Raszynianka from doing so is Magda Linette. Our tennis players will meet on the court for only the second time in history. They previously faced each other in 2023 in Beijing. Świątek emerged victorious from that match, winning 6:1, 6:1

Each episode of this series will be devoted to a different one. We will see what challenges tennis players and their teams have to face. Cameras accompanied them during their stay in the capital of Saudi Arabia, but they also talked about events from the entire season. The best Polish tennis player sums up the 2025 season with one, but very accurate, word. Iga Świątek and her staff return to the most important challenges they had to face. They explain what was the key to success and reveal the backstage of the conversations that changed the fate of the season. Poland. 2025-2026. documentary series

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Miami - singles final match: Aryna Sabalenka - Coco Gauff

programme.desc: Once again, Jeremy Wade sets off in search of bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Several hundred passengers died in the disaster of the Sobral Santos ship on the Amazon River. Many people were eaten alive after being in the water. Jeremy takes a closer look at the tragic events and explains what happened. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 6 – Bone Breaker | S06E02
programme.desc: Once again, Jeremy Wade sets off in search of bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Someone finds a body with unusual injuries. Jeremy starts looking for another river monster. He learns about a series of unexplained disappearances and a mysterious creature living in the river. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: River Monsters 6 – Man-Eating Monster | S06E03
programme.desc: Once again, Jeremy Wade sets off in search of bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. programme.title: River Monsters 6 – Jungle Terminator | S06E04
programme.desc: Once again, Jeremy Wade sets off in search of bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. programme.title: River Monsters 6 – River of Blood | S06E05
programme.desc: Once again, Jeremy Wade sets off in search of bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits different parts of the world. programme.title: African predators: the big four – Lions | E01
programme.desc: The lives of the four largest predators living in Africa will be presented. The creators will look at their hunting methods, competition in herds, as well as strategies that ensure their survival in sometimes difficult conditions... Spain, Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: Pacific – On the high seas | S01E01
programme.desc: The creators of the program talk about the Pacific Ocean, the largest ocean in the world, covering an area of ​​170 million square kilometers. Viewers will have the opportunity to look at the coral reef and see the local beaches and capes. They will also learn about the inhabitants of water, from crabs and sea cows to the more predatory rulers of the ocean. The creators of the program present viewers the Pacific Ocean, an ocean that covers almost half of the world. They explain that its waters could accommodate seven continents. Canada. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Secrets of water lands – Oceans | S01E01
programme.desc: The authors invite viewers on underwater journeys through oceans, swamps and other water areas from around the world. In each episode, they show the richness of the ecosystems they visit, presenting the complex relationships between the organisms inhabiting them. Filmmakers dive into the darkest depths of the ocean to see the most mysterious creatures. They accompany humpback whales as they traverse vast open waters and admire the breathtaking phenomenon of bioluminescence on the ocean floor. Great Britain. 2025. nature series

programme.title: The wildest Latin America – Andes | E05
programme.desc: Latin America is one of the most diverse areas in the world. The largest tropical forests, vast swamps and the longest mountain chain are located here. Thanks to this series, viewers will see beautiful views and impressive rock formations in the Andes, lush Amazonian vegetation and Venezuelan wetlands. Each episode of the series is devoted to one region. It shows its natural environment, fauna and flora. The Andes are the longest mountain range in the world, stretching along the entire western coast of South America. The Inca civilization had its cradle here, the traces of which are best seen in Machu Picchu. The Andes also attract mountaineers who treat climbing Aconcagua as training before conquering Mount Everest. The authors of the series look at how animals living here cope at high altitudes. Netherlands. 2012. documentary series

programme.title: In Search of Rain | E03
programme.desc: A herd of elephants faces a challenge when the river dries up due to lack of rain. Phoenix, the leader of a pack of wild dogs, is fighting against time: she has to feed five puppies. A herd of elephants with two newborn cubs splits up. Thanks to this decision, parents intend to make better use of the life-giving resources available in this extremely dry area. After the sudden disappearance of her partner, Phoenix, the female tries to find a new companion. Canada. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Scottish pines
programme.desc: The Scots pine is one of the symbols of Scotland. This species of tree is now planted in the highlands there as part of wildlife restoration projects. This may be their return after a long time, because this is where they grew before... Great Britain. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Animal Wars – Cold Fury | E01
programme.desc: Animal species will be presented that can use their amazing features to defeat sometimes larger opponents. By perfecting them, they became true masters of communication, combat and camouflage. The world of snow, extreme cold and icy waters means that animals are always ready for battle. programme.desc: «The least expected day: Ep.1» The old guard receives the recording of a new season of the series with many cautions. However, the new generation sees it as an opportunity. They are very different personalities, two very different worlds that share a team. Enric Mas, the veteran leader of the men's team, opens up more to the rest of his teammates. It is a renewed Enric, closer. He is preparing for the Tour with more ambition than ever. Iván Romeo is the visible head of a group of young runners who want to change things. He is ambitious, close, natural and with the soul of a leader. We know his most intimate side. He comes from a family passionate about cycling. As a child I traveled to France to watch the Tour go by from the sidelines. Now he is preparing for his first appearance in the race. His consecration comes in Dauphiné. With his stage victory, all the emotions come out. It has taken a while to get to where it is, but it is now a reality. In the Tour the first problems arrive for Enric

programme.title: The least expected day: Episode 1
programme.desc: «The least expected day: Ep.2» In the Tour, Enric does not go. What few know is that he suffers a major injury that weakens him more every day. In the middle of the chaos, Ivan Romeo appears. He dreams of his first stage in the Tour. On the women's team, Reusser has arrived to be the leader, but she has had problems for a long time. His crown in the Giro seems close, but the ghosts of the past return. She cries inconsolably after a great effort without reward. It is an example of improvement, but you will have to continue fighting. In addition, another figure stands out in the team, Liane Lippert. After the Tour, the men's team prepares for the race on which they have all their hopes: the Vuelta. However, Enric fails to recover in time. It's a suit for everyone. Iran without a leader. However, it is the perfect time to see the younger ones. That's when an unexpected figure appears. Aular flies and surprises directors and colleagues

programme.title: The least expected day: Episode 2
programme.desc: «The least expected day: Ep.3» The challenge is huge. The idea is to hunt stages. Enric supports the team from a distance, while the new generation in charge of leading the race fights with hunger. Reusser has overcome her problems and becomes CRI world and European champion. Face a new season with all its ghosts chased away. Meanwhile, in the men's Vuelta victory is very close, but something always fails at the last minute. It is an atypical and complicated return, but the team does not lose focus. Romo cherishes glory, but has to end up abandoning due to a fall. Communication problems appear between directors and brokers. To solve them, the figure of the psychologist is key. The year ends and the results are not as expected. A question appears in the air: when will the Movistar Team win again? The answer is optimism. The new generation is here to stay. to win

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Abel Resino» Abel Resino holds the unbeaten record in the history of LaLiga. As an Atlético de Madrid player, he entered the Guinness Book by keeping a clean sheet for 1,275 minutes, which goes from November 25, 1990, in which Claudio scored a goal against him in Mallorca-Atlético and March 17, 1991, on matchday 26, when Luis Enrique managed to beat him in the 45th minute of Atlético-Sporting de Gijón played in Vicente Calderon. A total of 14 consecutive games without conceding a goal in the 1990/1991 season. A mark that is still valid in professional football and that helped him win the Zamora trophy with 17 goals conceded in 33 games. Champion of the Copa del Rey, in 1995 he decided to sign for Rayo Vallecano of Madrid to play his last active season. Abel played a total of 264 games in the highest category of Spanish football

programme.title: 30 for 30: Celtics/Lakers: Part 1
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/f Sunken treasures of the Nubian pharaohs
programme.desc: The 2,300-year-old royal tomb of a Nubian pharaoh appears largely intact, submerged in rising groundwater. The Water Tomb of Nastasen is located at the ancient site of Nuri, which lies on more than 170 acres of sand along the eastern bank of the Nile River in northern Sudan. When viewed from the sky, its most impressive feature is the arch of about 20 pyramids built between 650 BC and 300 BC. These pyramids are marked by the burials of Kushitic royalty, the "black pharaohs" who acted as vassals in the gold-rich southern fringes of the Egyptian Empire, but who emerged as a force in their own right during the political chaos that followed the decline of the New Empire. programme.title: America's Wild Seasons: Winter (S1E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, Kanada, 2019. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2019 г. Год: 2019. Страна: JAV, Kanada. Год: 2019. S1, Ep4 «America's Wild Seasons»…Winter is the ultimate challenge. As temperatures plunge across much of America, some animals escape to milder climes of the South, while others stay put and tough out the brutal cold and blizzards that blanket the North | The wilds of America are vast and untamed. Over the course of a year, this immersive documentary series investigates the perils and challenges faced by the animals that inhabit these ferocious wildernesses. Through winter, spring, summer and autumn witness how the ever changing conditions affect life on land, below the waves and in the air. The personalities and characters of certain animals will develop as the series progress and you will find yourself rooting for your favourites to survive as the seasons go by. America's seasons are wild and extreme posing many trails to the varied wildlife that live there. From freezing rains to scorching deserts, the weather is as scary and unpredictable as it could possibly be. Nature documentary series | Director: Jeff Morales | Cast: Scott McNeil

programme.title: Coastal Africa: Algoa Bay: Last Refuge Of the African Penguin (S1E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2016. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2016 г. Год: 2016. Страна: JAV. Год: 2016. S1, Ep4 «Coastal Africa»…The population of African penguins in Southern Africa is on the decline, the charismatic species has found a stronghold on two islands in Algoa Bay. This is the story of the penguins' daily struggle to raise families in an unforgiving and hostile environment | Renowned for its big game animals such as lions, elephants, rhinos and cheetahs, Africa is a continent packed with diverse wildlife and remarkable creatures. But not all of its wild beauty can be found inland, and this documentary series examines its vibrant, thriving coastlines, exploring these underwater worlds that are home to a diverse array of phenomenal creatures. At the continent's southernmost tip, two ocean currents collide creating a rich environment that can sustain a variety of marine plants and in turn a number of spectacular creatures, including humpback whales, penguins, great white sharks, and dolphins | Director: Claudio Velasquez-Rojas | Cast: Tapfuma Makina

programme.title: Hard working animals. Jackals
programme.desc: The most elegant among the kidnappers are black-backed jackals. They live in Africa and make a living by taking advantage of everything the savannah has to offer. They are often found on the sidelines of banquets hosted by the most powerful inhabitants of the savannas - lions, vultures and hyenas. The black-backed jackal knows how to find the right moment. You need to be patient, judge the distance correctly and be fast. Stealing from a hyena or lion is a dangerous activity: one bite and a slow, painful death. In nature, not all thieves are as cunning and elegant as the black-backed jackal. Some animals look like gangsters. Spain, 2019, educational

programme.title: Hard working animals. 8 p.

programme.title: d/f Giants of Wildlife. 2 s.

programme.title: d/f Animals at night
programme.desc: After sunset, nature does not freeze - it changes its face. While some animals fall asleep, others go out hunting. Night animals act quickly: you need to get food, avoid enemies and not miss a minute. Among them are not only large predators, but also tiny creatures forced to take risks in order to survive. How do they navigate in the dark? Why do they prefer a nocturnal lifestyle? Modern technologies have helped scientists look into this world and uncover the secrets of nighttime activity.

programme.title: d/f Green Belt of Europe
programme.desc: The Iron Curtain once divided Europe, creating a neutral zone with barbed wire, patrols and strict borders. However, this strip of land, while remaining virtually untouched by humans, has become a haven for wildlife. Today, the area along the former curtain is known as the European Green Belt, a unique natural corridor that unites dozens of countries. France, 2023

programme.title: d/f Cheetah. From hunter to prey
programme.desc: This program takes us into the world of wildlife, where cheetahs are constantly fighting for survival. We will see their life path from cubs to adults, reveal the peculiarities of daytime hunting and learn how much strength speed takes away, as a result of which other predators often take away the cheetah’s prey. The survival of the fastest beast on Earth involves overcoming many difficulties, and this struggle cannot but inspire admiration. The cheetah is a perfect creature, the fastest land animal among mammals. Of all the representatives of the cat family, this animal is one of the most adapted to life in its habitat, the African savannah. Thanks to its impeccable aerodynamic body structure with an incredibly flexible back, powerful muscles and long legs, the cheetah reaches speeds of over one hundred kilometers per hour in a few seconds! A rather massive tail allows it to change direction with lightning speed in pursuit of ungulates running in zigzags, and an intensely working heart and lungs make it possible to run at top speeds. Spain, 2016

programme.title: THẠCH HẦU TRỞ VỀ - THE MONKEY IS BACK
programme.desc: Vị cứu tinh của mọi người, Stone Monkey, đã mang lại hy vọng cho một cô bé tuyệt vọng mà anh hứa sẽ nhận ra. Nhiều năm sau, Stone Monkey bị đánh bại trong trận chiến với Thần chiến tranh ba mắt, khiến hắn mất đi sức mạnh và rơi xuống phàm trần. Liệu anh ta có thể thực hiện lời hứa của mình với cô gái và ngăn chặn Thần Rừng hủy diệt trái đất?

programme.title: BÃO TỐ BANGKOK - BANGKOK STORM
programme.desc: Võ sĩ ngầm Lin Feng bị bộ ba Bangkok truy lùng khi từ chối đấu trong một trận đấu trái luật. Anh trốn thoát thành công nhưng bị mất trí nhớ. Trong khi Feng bắt đầu cuộc sống mới, hội tam hoàng tìm thấy anh và thuê một võ sĩ hàng đầu để đánh bại anh. Khi Feng đột nhiên lấy lại trí nhớ trong quá trình đó, anh thề sẽ tiêu diệt bộ ba.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: VÕ TÒNG BÁO THÙ - WUSONG VS XIMENQING
programme.desc: Ngô Song phát hiện ra chuyện chị dâu ngoại tình với một người đàn ông giàu có, Tây Môn Khánh. Qing gài bẫy Song và đày anh ta trong một năm, trong thời gian đó người anh trai kém may mắn của anh ta bị sát hại và hỏa táng. Cuối cùng, khi Song trở về nhà, anh đưa vụ án ra tòa nhưng thẩm phán gạt nó sang một bên và đột ngột đóng lại. Liệu Song cuối cùng có thể trả thù cho cái chết của anh trai mình?

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!
